d:
Get ready to dance with "Koka" from the movie "Babe Bhangra Paunde Ne". This song is sung by the superstar "Diljit Dosanjh" and features the beautiful "Sargun Mehta". It is composed by "Avvy Sra" and is penned by "Raj Ranjodh".
Babe Bhangra Paunde Ne releasing Worldwide on 5th Oct 2022
